name: SANTONINUM
key_symptoms: Occipital headache, with chromatic hallucinations. Itching of nose. Bores into nostrils.
guiding_symptoms: Occipital headache, with chromatic hallucinations. Itching of nose. Bores into nostrils.
head_symptoms: Occipital headache, with chromatic hallucinations. Itching of nose. Bores into nostrils.
urinary_symptoms: Urine greenish if acid and reddish purple if alkaline. Incontinence and dysuria. Enuresis. Feeling of fullness of bladder. Nephritis.

source.title: SANTONINUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
